message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live API calls to VirusTotal from this environment.  
Below is a quick guide you can follow locally to retrieve the CNAME record IDs for `sample.com`:

```bash
# 1. Get the domain object ID
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com" \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123"

# 2. Extract the domain ID from the response (look for `"id": "<DOMAIN_ID>"`)

# 3. Retrieve related objects of type CNAME
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/<DOMAIN_ID>/related_objects?object_type=cname" \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123"

# 4. In the JSON response, each CNAME object will contain an `"id"` field.
#    Those are the IDs you’re looking for.
```

If you run these commands, the last step will give you a list of CNAME record IDs for `sample.com`.
